text: Two secret words used one after the other on the table add up: each place uses one slot of each word, and each known letter forces their total.
Drawn for SHADING on the message and INVISIBLE on the copper; the experiment tried all 102 x 102 pairs built from K1 to K3 words and the 2025 words.
1,747,872 cases: 2,042 pairs of lengths survive, none with a total below 21, which is what chance leaves; no survivor is made of puzzle words.
